technical.summary: Mixed intermediate-term bullish structure (EMA 20/50, Ichimoku, Supertrend) undermined by weak short-term momentum, bearish candle pattern, and price rejection below key moving averages; insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 81 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no clear directional bias; market sentiment neutral with moderate greed; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, VIX at crisis levels (103.3), NFP event imminent, and negative macro score (-7) create severe near-term headwinds despite 81-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Intermediate-term bullish structure (EMA 20/50 bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, Supertrend bullish) with price near support (81.54) offers potential mean-reversion setup if macro stress abates.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX 103.3 crisis, inverted yield curve, NFP imminent), weak short-term momentum (price below EMA 9/21/200, three black crows, StochRSI oversold, low volume), zero fundamental conviction, and high earnings risk in 81 days create overwhelming risk/reward imbalance.
